battle.name: 第二次巴巴利戰爭
battle.brief: 一八一五年三月，國會授權海軍對付阿爾及爾私掠；五月，迪凱特率十艘船自紐約出發，六月於加塔角外海奪巴巴里旗艦馬舒達號、帕洛斯角外海再取快船，七月三日逼阿爾及爾議和停繳歲貢。卡面輪發槍，是此類戰役中配給軍官與衛兵的後膛手槍。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰一方是美利堅合眾國，另一方是阿爾及爾的迪伊與攝政庭。華盛頓方面的決策者是總統詹姆斯·麥迪遜：一八一五年三月三日，國會通過法案，授權海軍在大西洋、地中海及鄰近海域保護美國商船與船員，授權總統按「其所認為必要」動用海軍武力、徵用私掠船並扣押阿爾及爾的船貨。美國並未以正式宣戰的方式開戰，法律形式是「授權動用海軍」。實際作戰由地中海分艦隊承擔：一八一五年五月二十日，十艘軍艦自紐約啟程，旗艦為一八一四年下水的四十四砲巡洋艦 Guerriere，同行的 Constellation、Macedonian 為三十六砲巡洋艦，Epervier、Ontario、Firefly、Spark、Flambeau、Torch、Spitfire 七艘則是十四砲雙桅快帆船。巴巴里一方是歐瑪·阿加（Omar Agha，稱「青年迪伊」）攝政下的海軍國家，兵力由巡洋快船（xebec）、沿岸砲台與精於縱火劫掠的船員組成，另有艦隊總帥與海軍法庭直接統制。此時歐洲列強仍深陷拿破崙戰爭，無力插手地中海，阿爾及爾得以一面攔截美國與歐洲商船、一面照舊徵收歲貢，這正是美方認為必須單獨出兵的理由。而一八一五年的地中海並非只有阿爾及爾一端：的黎波里與突尼斯的統治者在同阿爾及爾的角力中傾向美國（此點在歐洲報紙與美國海軍檔案中屢有記載，細節多有出入），美軍航線亦經巴巴利海岸中段的水域通過；真正決定戰局的三個地點，則是加塔角、帕洛斯角與阿爾及爾灣。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the United States of America, the other the Dey and Regency of Algiers. In Washington the decision belonged to President James Madison: on 3 March 1815 the Congress passed an act authorising the Navy to protect American commerce and seamen in the Atlantic, the Mediterranean and the adjoining seas, and authorising the President, as judged requisite, to use naval force, to commission privateers and to seize Algerian vessels and goods. The United States never issued a formal declaration of war; the legal form was an authorisation to use the fleet. The fighting was done by the Mediterranean squadron. On 20 May 1815 ten ships sailed from New York, the flagship being the forty-four gun USS Guerriere, launched in 1814, together with the thirty-six gun frigates Constellation and Macedonian and seven fourteen gun brigs, Epervier, Ontario, Firefly, Spark, Flambeau, Torch and Spitfire. The Algerine side was the naval state of the Regency under the Dey Omar Agha, the Young Dey, built on xebecs, shore batteries and crews skilled in fire and plunder, with a fleet admiral and a naval court exercising direct control. The European powers were still locked in the Napoleonic Wars and could not intervene in the Mediterranean, so Algiers was able to keep stopping American and European merchantmen while still collecting its tribute; that inability of Europe to act is exactly why the United States believed it had to fight alone. The Mediterranean of 1815 was not only about Algiers: the rulers of Tripoli and Tunis leaned towards the Americans in their quarrel with Algiers, a point recorded in the European papers and in the American naval files though the details differ, and the American route ran through the middle waters of the Barbary coast; the three places that actually decided the campaign were Cape Gata, Cape Palos and the Bay of Algiers.
people: 美方的核心人物是准將史蒂芬·迪凱特（Stephen Decatur），第一次巴巴利戰爭的老將，本役由他一手主持：六月十七日加塔角（Cape Gata）外海、十九日帕洛斯角（Cape Palos）外海連打兩日，奪下巴巴里旗艦馬舒達號（Meshouda）與快船艾斯特迪奧號（Estedio）；六月二十七日（據美方航行日誌記載），迪凱特另以一艘巡洋艦與一艘武裝快船突入阿爾及爾港，在泊滿岸邊的巴巴里艦隊之間以短炮急射其側舷，隨即整隊退出，把歐瑪·阿加逼上談判桌。分艦隊中另有資深艦長威廉·舒布里克等人隨行，其後被派往地中海主持對阿爾及爾的交涉；原定由威廉·班布里奇率領、準備接應的更大艦隊最終未及參戰。巴巴里一方的私掠艦隊由賴斯·哈米杜（Raïs Hamidou）統率，此人在加塔角與帕洛斯角兩役中陣亡。華盛頓方面，麥迪遜拍板，海軍部長班傑明·克朗寧希爾德掌管經費與人事，國會則於一八一五年十二月五日批准條約。巴巴里一方，歐瑪·阿加在談判中節節退讓，其後卻與一八一六年新即位的阿里·霍賈一同否認對美國與歐洲各國的承諾；一八一六年英荷聯合介入時，英國海軍上將愛德華·佩洛接管戰局，美國則再派專員威廉·沙勒赴阿爾及爾催索賠款與被扣船貨。
peopleEn: The central figure was Commodore Stephen Decatur, a veteran of the First Barbary War, who directed the campaign from beginning to end: in June he took the Algerine flagship Meshouda off Cape Gata on 17 June and the brig Estedio off Cape Palos on 19 June, and on 27 June, according to the American ship's logs, he drove Guerriere and an armed fast vessel into the harbour of Algiers, raking the tightly packed Algerine hulls with short carronades before withdrawing in order, which pushed Omar Agha to the negotiating table. Senior captains such as William Shubrick served in the squadron and were afterwards entrusted with American dealings at Algiers; the larger force that William Bainbridge was expected to bring up never reached the theatre in time. In Washington Madison gave the order, Benjamin Crowninshield as Secretary of the Navy controlled the money and the appointments, and the Congress ratified the treaty on 5 December 1815. On the Algerine side Omar Agha gave ground step by step in the negotiation and then, together with Ali Khodja who came to the throne in 1816, repudiated the promises made to the United States and to the European powers alike; the privateering fleet itself was commanded by the Raïs Hamidou, who was killed in the fighting off Cape Gata and Cape Palos. When the Anglo-Dutch force intervened in 1816 command passed to Admiral Edward Pellew, and the United States sent the commissioner William Shaler to Algiers to press for the indemnity and the seized shipping.
kits: 卡面這件輪發槍（Wheellock pistol）是火繩槍時代的後膛手槍，靠發條上緊的機械點火機構擊發火繩，最早見於十六世紀初的歐洲，到一八一五年已是三百年的老式兵器，線部隊早已改用燧發手槍。本役真正發揮火力的，是艦炮與步槍：旗艦 Guerriere 為四十四砲，以二十四磅卡隆短炮搭配三十二磅長炮；十四砲雙桅快帆船按海軍編制以六門三十二磅、八門二十四磅短炮組成，射程雖短，但彈道平直、裝填迅速，正適合追擊高舷側的巴巴里快船。接舷與登陸時，美軍水手與海軍陸戰隊用滑膛燧發步槍、卡賓槍、彎刀與手槍，巴巴里水手則以火繩與燧發槍配合船首的長身旋轉炮，在攀舷混戰中大量使用。輪發槍本身在本役的直接紀錄極為有限：美國海軍軍官與護衛的標準配備已是燧發手槍，輪發槍主要殘留在西班牙與義大利的近衛、砲兵衛隊及少數州民兵手中，成為軍官與衛兵階層的象徵性配備，而非左右戰局的火力。更關鍵的是甲板上的海水：浪花與海霧對簧輪機件的傷害遠大於對火繩的傷害，槍機一旦進水就難以擊發，所以輪發槍幾乎不可能是海上實戰的武器。它在本役的位置，只能是岸上衛兵與軍官手上那支「有資格開火」的後膛手槍；而巴巴里船上的貼身戰——登船、割帆、砍纜——同樣是一場以手槍與短刀為主的窄地格鬥。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, the wheellock pistol, is a matchlock-era handgun that fires from the breech, igniting the priming powder with a clockwork mechanism wound by a mainspring; it first appears in Europe in the early sixteenth century, and by 1815 it was a three-hundred-year-old relic that line troops had long since replaced with flintlock pistols. The real firepower in this campaign lay in the ships' guns and muskets: the flagship Guerriere carried forty-four guns, combining twenty-four pound carronades with thirty-two pound long guns, while the fourteen gun brigs, according to the navy establishment, were armed with six thirty-two pound and eight twenty-four pound carronades, short in range but flat in trajectory and quick to reload, which suited them exactly for chasing the high freeboard of the xebecs. In boarding and landing the American sailors and marines used flintlock smoothbore muskets, carbines, cutlasses and pistols, while the Algerine crews worked matchlock and flintlock guns together with long swivel guns on the bow, used in showers during the fight to board. The direct record of the wheellock itself in 1815 is very thin: the standard sidearm of American officers and guards was already the flintlock pistol, and wheellocks survived mainly in the guard detachments and artillery batteries of Spain and Italy and in a few state militias, where they had become a symbolic issue for officers and sentries rather than a decisive source of firepower. More telling is the salt water: spray and fog spoil a clockwork lock far more readily than they spoil a match, and once the mechanism takes in water it will not fire, so a wheellock was very nearly useless as a weapon at sea. Its place in this war can only be that of the breech-loading pistol carried ashore by sentries and officers, the sidearm of the man qualified to shoot; and the close-quarters fighting aboard the Algerine ships, boarding, cutting rigging, chopping cables, was in the same way a cramped duel of pistols and short blades.
tactics: 巴巴里私掠的戰術核心不是排會戰，而是選擇打擊目標：巡洋快船憑速度與縱帆性能沿大航路截擊商船，避開成建制的巡洋艦，把風險轉嫁成一條航線的安全問題。美國要破壞這個模式，就必須同時封鎖海岸、追擊快船，並直接威脅阿爾及爾港。六月加塔角外海一役（六月十七日），美軍以縱隊接戰，旗艦 Guerriere 咬住巴巴里大旗艦 Meshouda，以卡隆短炮在短距離內傾瀉砲火，逼其豎旗；帕洛斯角外海（六月十九日）則由分艦截住快船 Estedio。二十七日，迪凱特另以一艘巡洋艦與一艘武裝快船駛入阿爾及爾港，在密集泊岸的巴巴里艦隊之間急射側舷短炮，隨即藉斜風快速脫出；這是一場高風險奇襲，賭的是岸上砲台的反應時間與自方的裝填速度。巴巴里方則以沿岸砲台、快船分散游走與拖延談判應對，拒絕在美軍優勢火力下打決定性會戰。補給方面，美軍自紐約經直布羅陀轉入地中海，全程逾四千海里，沿途以直布羅陀、馬耳他與西西里為中途取水、補充糧秣與修船的節點。
tacticsEn: The heart of Barbary privateering was not the fleet battle but the choice of target: xebecs used their speed and their lateen rigs to intercept merchantmen on the great routes and avoided squadrons of frigates, turning the risk into a question of the security of a shipping lane. To break that pattern the Americans had to blockade the coast, chase the xebecs and threaten Algiers harbour itself. In the action off Cape Gata on 17 June the American squadron engaged in line, Guerriere closing on the great Algerine flagship Meshouda and pouring carronade fire into her at short range until she struck; off Cape Palos on 19 June an element of the squadron cut off the brig Estedio. On 27 June Decatur drove a frigate and an armed fast ship into the harbour of Algiers, raked the closely packed Algerine hulls with their short guns and slid out at once on a slant wind; it was a raid of high risk, wagering on the reaction time of the shore batteries and on the speed of reloading. The Algerines answered with their shore batteries, with xebecs dispersed and cruising, and with delaying the negotiation, refusing a decisive engagement against an opponent who commanded the better gunnery. On the logistics side the American squadron covered more than four thousand nautical miles from New York by Gibraltar into the Mediterranean, drawing water, provisions and repairs at Gibraltar, Malta and Sicily on the way.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力、條款與日期三處。兵力方面：美方出動十艘船，即一艘四十四砲旗艦、兩艘三十六砲巡洋艦與七艘十四砲雙桅快帆船；巴巴里方被奪的是旗艦 Meshouda 與快船 Estedio，交戰時其灣內另有五艘護衛艦與七艘小型戰船，加上沿岸砲台與大量巡洋快船。時間線：國會授權三月三日，艦隊五月二十日自紐約啟程，六月下旬連戰，一八一五年七月三日條約在阿爾及爾灣的 Guerriere 號上簽訂，同年十二月五日經參議院批准。條款數字：巴巴里方面歸還全部美俘，約十人；美方依約交還巴巴里俘虜約五百人，並另付一萬美元，賠償先前被扣船貨的損失。兩役的損失亦可對照：美方陣亡十人、受傷三十人；巴巴里方陣亡五十三人、被俘四百八十六人，兩艘戰船被奪、一艘被擊沉。收尾的難題：載著獲釋美國水手的 Epervier 號於八月九日在大西洋沉沒，十人無一倖存；一八一六年英荷聯合打擊中，英方出動五艘主力艦，荷方再添六艘小艇，八月二十七日對阿爾及爾城連續轟炸九小時，最終釋放一千零八十三名被擄的基督徒；一八一六年十二月二十三日美阿另訂新約，直到一八二二年二月十一日才完成批准。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around force, terms and dates. On force: the United States sent ten ships, one forty-four gun flagship, two thirty-six gun frigates and seven fourteen gun brigs; the Algerine prizes were the flagship Meshouda and the brig Estedio, and in the fighting their side had five frigates and seven smaller craft inside the bay, besides the shore batteries and the swarm of xebecs. On chronology: congressional authorisation on 3 March, the squadron sailing from New York on 20 May, the fighting in late June, the treaty signed on 3 July 1815 aboard the Guerriere in the Bay of Algiers and ratified by the Senate on 5 December of the same year. On terms: Algiers returned every American captive, about ten men; the United States handed back about five hundred subjects of the Dey and paid a further ten thousand dollars for the shipping that had been seized. The two actions can also be weighed against each other: ten Americans killed and thirty wounded, against fifty-three Algerines killed and four hundred and eighty-six captured, two vessels taken and one more sunk. Then the loose ends: the Epervier, which carried the liberated American sailors, sank in the Atlantic on 9 August and all ten aboard were lost; in the Anglo-Dutch attack of 1816 the British brought five ships of the line and the Dutch added six small vessels, bombarding Algiers for nine hours on 27 August and finally releasing one thousand and eighty-three Christian captives; a further treaty with the United States was signed on 23 December 1816 and was not ratified until 11 February 1822.
cause: 直接起因是戰後地中海航運的復甦與巴巴里私掠的再度活躍。一八一二年戰爭結束後，美國商船重回地中海，的黎波里與突尼斯的私掠船隊尚未解散，阿爾及爾更把美國商船視為穩定而厚實的獵物：一八一五年初，阿爾及爾的巡洋快船攔截美國商船並擄走船員，而按古老慣例，這些人被要求由美國政府用公帑贖回，等於政府直接為劫掠行為付帳。美國國內對「每年付一筆歲貢給海盜」這套說法早已不耐，加上與英國的海洋權利之爭尚在僵持，而歐洲列強自顧不暇、無力干預，國會遂在三月三日授權總統以海軍武力回應。更深一層的背景，是一七九五年以來美國與巴巴里諸國的「納貢換和平」體系本身已走到盡頭：第一次巴巴利戰爭美國雖然打贏了，卻沒有拆掉對方的快船生產與岸砲體系，巴巴里的掠奪收益從未中斷，而美國能選的只有「打贏」或「繼續付錢」兩條路。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the revival of Mediterranean trade after the war and the renewed activity of Barbary privateering. When the war of 1812 ended, American merchantmen returned to the Mediterranean before the privateering fleets of Tripoli and Tunis had been dispersed, and Algiers treated them as a regular and lucrative quarry: in the early months of 1815 Algerine xebecs stopped American ships and carried off their crews, and by ancient custom the men were ransomed by the United States government out of the public treasury, which meant the government paid the raider's bill directly. American patience with the respectable fiction of paying a yearly tribute to pirates had long worn out, and with the maritime quarrel with Britain still frozen and the European powers unable to act while they fought Napoleon, the Congress authorised the President to answer with naval force on 3 March. Deeper down lay the fact that the tribute-for-peace system which had governed American relations with the Barbary states since 1795 had reached its limit: although the United States had won the First Barbary War, it had not broken the Algerine building of xebecs and shore batteries, the corsair income never stopped, and Washington was left with only two choices, to win or to go on paying.
impact: 本役最直接的效果，是把「以海軍武力代替歲貢」這條路走通了。歐洲隨後的做法如出一轍：一八一六年英國海軍上將愛德華·佩洛率五艘主力艦南下，荷方再添六艘小艇，於八月二十七日對阿爾及爾城連續轟炸九小時，用砲火把談判桌上的僵局硬生生打破；同年九月與十二月，美國再派專員威廉·沙勒赴約，把賠款與被扣船貨一併了結。此役之後，歐洲各國不再向巴巴里繳納歲貢，地中海的劫掠被壓到只剩零星個案，美國海軍也第一次靠一場地中海戰役在歐洲揚名，國會據此撥款建造更大的巡洋艦與戰列艦，私人資本也湧入海軍債與私掠授權。長遠的影響更延伸到非洲本身：阿爾及爾仍以歐洲俘虜充作宮廷與艦隊的人力，列強的砲艦一次次摧毀這套體系，卻沒有建立任何替代的統治；一八三〇年法軍攻取阿爾及爾，巴巴里海軍作為獨立的海上力量就此消失，掠奪的遺產只剩下歐洲人口販運與殖民貿易更大規模的重演。
impactEn: The most immediate effect of the war was to establish in practice the principle of answering the Barbary states with naval force rather than with tribute. Europe took the same road: in 1816 Admiral Edward Pellew took five ships of the line south, the Dutch added six small vessels, and on 27 August the fleet bombarded Algiers for nine hours, breaking the deadlock at the negotiating table with gunpowder; in September and again in December the same year the United States sent the commissioner William Shaler to settle the indemnity and the seized shipping. After this the European powers stopped paying tribute to the Barbary powers, Mediterranean piracy was reduced to a few scattered cases, and the American navy won its first Mediterranean name in Europe: the Congress funded the building of larger frigates and ships of the line, and private capital poured into navy bonds and privateering commissions. The longer consequences reached into Africa itself. Algiers went on manning its court and its squadrons with European captives, and the guns of the powers destroyed that system again and again without putting anything in its place; in 1830 the French took Algiers and the Barbary fleets disappeared as an independent maritime force, leaving behind nothing but the traffic in slaves and the colonial trade of Europe carried out on a far larger scale.
result: 結果可以分成兩段。戰役本身是美國勝得乾淨：加塔角與帕洛斯角兩役連勝，奪下旗艦 Meshouda 與快船 Estedio，迪凱特的阿爾及爾港奇襲迫使歐瑪·阿加於一八一五年七月三日登上 Guerriere 號甲板簽約——巴巴里方面歸還全部美俘並支付一萬美元，美國則停止繳納歲貢，取得地中海自由通商權，條約於同年十二月五日經參議院批准。麻煩出在後續：歐瑪·阿加在條約生效之前便翻臉否認，同一屆裡對歐洲各國的承諾也一併推翻，新即位的阿里·霍賈同樣不認舊約，於是美國在一八一六年又得再派艦隊。最後收場的是英荷聯軍那九小時轟炸——阿爾及爾屈服，釋放一千零八十三名被擄的基督徒，一八一六年十二月二十三日另訂新約，直到一八二二年二月十一日才完成批准。巴巴里的海上掠奪自此元氣大傷，卻並未立刻消失：真正終結這套體系的是一八三〇年的法國征服，而不是任何一場海上戰役。
resultEn: The result divides into two phases. The campaign itself was a clean American success: victories off Cape Gata and off Cape Palos took the flagship Meshouda and the brig Estedio, and Decatur's raid into the harbour of Algiers forced Omar Agha to sign aboard the Guerriere on 3 July 1815, with Algiers returning every American captive and paying ten thousand dollars, the United States stopping the tribute and obtaining free navigation in the Mediterranean, the treaty ratified by the Senate on 5 December of the same year. The trouble lay in what followed: before the treaty took effect Omar Agha repudiated it, and in the same breath overturned the promises made to the European powers, and Ali Khodja, newly come to the throne, would not recognise the old agreements either, so the United States had to send a squadron again in 1816. In the end it was the nine-hour bombardment of the Anglo-Dutch force that settled the matter: Algiers yielded, released one thousand and eighty-three Christian captives, and a further treaty was signed on 23 December 1816, not ratified until 11 February 1822. Barbary piracy was left badly weakened but was by no means gone; what finally closed the system was the French conquest of 1830, and not any single battle at sea.
